epicScope.note: Candidate stories S1-S4 — BA will refine into child stories during Phase 1 (BRD). Do NOT treat as final scope.
epicScope.S1: Agent definition format v2 — .code-intel/agents/*.md gains persona body semantics (system prompt section, role, phase defaults, model override optional); parser extended in chat-panel/ChatStateManager/fs-helpers.
epicScope.S2: selectAgent real wiring — agent switch loads the file, injects persona into session context (respecting skeleton/governance), sets SessionHostOptions.role/phase from agent definition instead of hardcoded 'sm-agent' (pi-workflow/pi-workflow-adapter/adapter-legacy-turns.ts:83).
epicScope.S3: Per-tab / per-agent session isolation — registry keying + per-tab budget/compaction (shared prerequisite with SA4E-369, design decision D1 there — coordinate, do not duplicate).
epicScope.S4: UI truthfulness — agent switch indicator, per-tab agent badge, per-agent conversation identity in history (tabs currently share one session's brain).
